Tobias R.: Hi finance — I bought 5 rail tickets for the Amsterdam workshop yesterday because the procurement portal was down. I paid on my personal card so I can get reimbursed, but the PDF receipt/invoice the vendor emailed lists the passenger name (me) as the buyer, not Redwood. They also included VAT on the invoice. Uploaded: train_receipt.pdf -> https://redwood-files/receipts/train_1935001234.pdf. How should I submit so we both reimburse me and get a corrected invoice for VAT reclaim?
Nina (Finance): Thanks @Tobias. Two asks: 1) submit a personal reimbursement expense with the full amount and attach the vendor receipt + your card statement line; 2) request a corrected invoice from the vendor showing "Redwood Inference, Inc." and our VAT ID so we can reclaim VAT. If the vendor won't reissue, finance can reimburse but we won't be able to reclaim the VAT.
expense-bot: To submit reimbursement and vendor-correction request, use:
```/expenses submit
amount: 245.60 EUR
category: travel - tickets
attach: train_receipt.pdf, personal_card_line.png
notes: "Group rail tickets for Amsterdam workshop 2026-06-12. Requesting vendor invoice reissue to Redwood Inference, Inc., VAT GB123456789 for reclaim. Vendor contact: bookings@eurorail.example, ref TXN-ER-4421"```
Tobias R.: Uploaded personal_card_line.png -> https://redwood-files/receipts/personal_card_1935001234.png. I already emailed the vendor asking for a corrected invoice (message attached): vendor_request_email.pdf -> https://redwood-files/receipts/vendor_email_1935001234.pdf. They replied automated: "invoice issued to buyer name" and asked for a company registration form before reissuing.
Nina (Finance): Ok — attach their reply and the vendor request. Finance can send a vendor registration PDF to accelerate reissue (we share minimal company details). If they require an official PO we can add the internal reference. If you expect delay, submit the reimbursement now and mark "vendor-correction-pending" in the notes so we track VAT reclaim separately.
Marcus (Manager): Approving manager sign-off for the reimbursement. Confirming business purpose: customer workshop travel for 5 attendees.
Tobias R.: Confirmed attendees: Tobias R., Elena M., Hugo P., Sanjay K., Priya L. Purpose: on-site workshop with Acme Corp. Total paid: 245.60 EUR.
vendor-bot: Vendor response logged: "Requested company details form to reissue invoice". Status: vendor-waiting -> /expenses vendor-ticket ER-4421
Nina (Finance): Great. Please submit per the expense-bot template and set notes = "vendor-correction-pending: vendor requested company reg form; finance sent form on 2026-06-13; will follow up." We'll reimburse the posted USD/EUR amount on the payroll run and open a VAT-ticket to follow up for reclaim if/when corrected invoice arrives. If vendor refuses permanently, we'll close the VAT-ticket noting non-reclaimable VAT.
Tobias R.: Submitted and tagged @Nina and @Marcus. Thanks for the quick guidance.
expense-bot: Submission received: status pending-approval -> /expenses view 1935001234
Nina (Finance): Received. I'll process reimbursement after manager approval and keep the vendor ticket open. Noting: reimburse in EUR and mark VAT as pending. Closing when vendor reissue confirmed. :white_check_mark:
